title: [impl] CLI create/update/delete commands
description:
Extend the CLI (built in gh-toy-mi2.1) with three write subcommands using the shared API client:
- create: requires --title and --content (--tag repeatable optional), POST /api/notes, print the created note.
- update: requires --id; --title and --content optional, PUT /api/notes/:id, print the updated note.
- delete: requires --id, DELETE /api/notes/:id, print confirmation.

Files (<=3): CLI entry/command file(s) and the api-client module.

Acceptance criteria:
- 'create --title X --content Y' creates a note and prints it, exit 0.
- 'update --id <id> --title Z' updates the note and prints it, exit 0.
- 'delete --id <id>' deletes the note and prints a confirmation, exit 0.
- Missing required args (e.g. create without --title) produce a clear stderr error and non-zero exit (no stack trace).
- Any API error yields a wrapped { error } style message on stderr and non-zero exit.

title: [impl] CLI scaffold, API client, and list/read commands

- read: requires --id, GET /api/notes/:id, print the note; non-zero exit if not found.
